regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 67". Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Bachelor is forecast for about 47". Crystal Mountain and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Thursday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 32". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Jay Peak is forecast for about 27". Whiteface and Mont-Sainte-Anne follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jay Peak Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Jay Peak from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 23", 15" of it Thursday. RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 26", 20" of it Saturday. Vail and Aspen Highlands follow.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Powder Mountain is forecast for about 16", 8" of it Saturday. Brighton and Solitude follow.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Sugar Bowl is forecast for about 14", 10" of it Sunday. Palisades and Northstar follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Sugar Bowl Sunday and Sunday night.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 14", 10" of it Thursday. SilverStar and Sun Peaks follow.

regions.title: Canadian Rockies
regions.text: Sunshine Village is forecast for about 8", 7" of it Thursday. Marmot Basin and Lake Louise follow.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
